Welcome to Tom Brolley’s Best Bets: 2026 NFL Futures edition. This will be the main hub for my favorite NFL futures bets starting in February and running through Super Bowl LXI. Be sure to check back regularly throughout the year to see what bets I like the best for the 2026 season.

This article will include my favorite wagers for season win totals, division/conference/Super Bowl winners, season-long player props, leader markets, award winners, and whatever other props are available at sportsbooks.

\>Subscribe to the Best Bets Podcast on your [favorite platform](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/podcasts/show/nfl-best-bets) and on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FantasyPointsBetting) for year-round NFL betting talk…Join our “#official-bets” [Fantasy Points Discord](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/discord) to see our staff's wagers as soon as we make them!
